te: Business sector heard on developing workers to meet market needs
se: The meeting considered the approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs, hearing a representative of the Thai Chamber of Commerce, who felt that developing workers must be based mainly on industry needs, especially as new graduates face employment challenges
it: Approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs

te: Department of Skill Development heard on industries of the future
se: The meeting considered the approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs, hearing the Department of Skill Development, which aims to support industries driven by technology and innovation that meet sustainability and environmental goals
it: Approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs

te: Study of workers for industries of the future (continued), and the Ranong foreign workers report
se: The meeting continued to consider the approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs, resolving to invite the Department of Skill Development to the next meeting, and considered the study report on managing foreign workers in Ranong Province
it: Approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs
Study report on managing foreign workers, Ranong Province

te: Federation of Thai Industries heard on upgrading workers' skills
se: The meeting considered the approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs, hearing a representative of the Federation of Thai Industries, who stated that Thailand still lacks workers with the skills manufacturers need, and proposed mechanisms to upgrade the workforce, such as a skills development platform, personal skills accounts and a national credit bank
it: Approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs

te: Migrant workers working group renamed, and study of workers for industries of the future begins
se: The meeting renamed the working group as the working group studying approaches to setting up an organisation to solve problems in managing migrant workers in Thailand, and began considering the approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs, which covers 10 target industry groups over the next 5 years
it: Renaming the working group on migrant workers
Approaches to developing workers for the industries of the future (S-Curve and New S-Curve), based on industry needs

te: Ranong study visit summarised, and drafting of the foreign workers report begins
se: The meeting considered the draft summary of the Ranong study visit, agreed to summarise recommendations to the Senate so that the results can be followed up, and noted that the working group had collected 200 questionnaires from workers and business operators for the study report on managing foreign workers in Ranong
it: Draft summary of the study visit to Ranong Province
Working group studying approaches to managing foreign workers, Ranong Province

te: Effects of foreign workers on education studied
se: The meeting felt that schools caring for foreign children who are not in the database receive insufficient budgets, so the problem should be solved in an integrated way by all agencies together, possibly with one agency directly responsible in future. It also noted the working group's field interviews with agencies
it: Approaches to solving problems related to foreign workers in Thailand

te: Information on foreign workers in Samut Sakhon Province heard
se: The meeting noted information that Samut Sakhon Province has an unregistered population almost as large as its registered population, so its budget is not enough to care for the people actually living there, and felt that the government should support the province as a model smart city managed with technology
it: Problems related to foreign workers in Samut Sakhon Province

te: Help for the families of Thai workers held hostage considered
se: The meeting considered help for Thai workers who went to work in the State of Israel and have been held hostage since October 2023, whose families reported that agencies had not yet contacted them, in order to coordinate with the agencies concerned to look after the families
it: Help for the families of Thai workers held hostage

te: Draft fact-finding report on the work permit project approved
se: The meeting noted the draft report on the preliminary facts gathered on the petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications, revised some wording, and approved submitting it to the Committee on Labour for consideration
it: Petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications

te: Information gathering on foreign workers in Ranong planned
se: The meeting followed up the work of the working group studying approaches to managing foreign workers in Ranong Province, and sought approval for in-depth interviews with 5 ministries, namely Labour, Public Health, Education, Interior and Culture, together with a questionnaire
it: Working group studying approaches to managing foreign workers, Ranong Province

te: Help for Thai workers held hostage followed up
se: The meeting gathered information on help for Thai workers held hostage abroad. Agencies reported that 5 have been released and 1 remain. It will propose that the committee continue to follow up and suggest ways to prevent risks in sending workers abroad. It also noted the progress of the working group studying the use of digital platforms to manage labour across the whole system
it: Request to follow up help for Thai workers held hostage
Working group studying the use of digital platforms to manage labour across the whole system

te: Consideration of the petition on the work permit project suspended for now
se: The petitioner indicated a wish to withdraw the petition on the contract to produce work permits. The meeting therefore suspended its consideration for now and asked the petitioner to state this intention formally in writing
it: Petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications

te: Department of Employment heard on the work permit project
se: The meeting gathered preliminary information on the petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications, inviting the Department of Employment to give the facts, and prepared to invite the petitioner to give information at the next meeting
it: Petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications

te: Study work assigned after the discussion with the minister, and the petition on the work permit project
se: The meeting was assigned to gather and analyse information from the joint meeting with the Minister of Labour and the Ranong study visit to prepare a study report, and considered the petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications, which concerns public procurement
it: Summary of information from the joint meeting with the Minister of Labour and the Ranong study visit
Petition asking for checks on the project contracting a private company to produce work permits and receive foreigners' applications

te: Structure and form of a labour bank discussed
se: The meeting held discussions with the Subcommittee on Finance of the Senate Committee on Economy, Monetary Affairs and Finance, experts and the Small and Medium Enterprise Development Bank of Thailand on the structure and form of a labour bank, and reached conclusions on a practical approach
it: Approaches to setting up a labour bank (a social security bank): structure and form
